text: Why Doug pay four dollars for gas in Texas...
but six dollars in California?
Same gas. Same Doug.
This is Doug. Doug drive snowmobile to work.
Snowmobile drink gas. Every day.
Doug fill up. Fifteen gallons. Doug watch numbers go up, up, up.
Gas come from oil. Oil come from ground.
Larry own refinery.
Larry turn oil into gas.
In Texas, many refineries. Lots of gas. Gas cheap.
In California, few refineries. Some close. Gas rare. Gas expensive.
And no pipe bring gas from Texas. California is alone.
Then Tax Gull come.
Texas gull take twenty cents. California gull take sixty cents. Every gallon.
And California want special summer gas. Special gas cost more to make. Only few refineries can make it.
Doug.
In real life, California gas is six twenty-three. Texas is three eighty-two.
Doug drive twelve thousand miles a year. In California, Doug pay over one thousand dollars more. Same snowmobile.
That is a lot of fish.
Doug move to Texas. Doug happy. Life is good.
Then Doug see Texas summer.
Doug is penguin.
Would you move for cheaper gas? Tell Doug in the comments.
